newsitem.title: USA: KEDO buys fuel oil from LG-Caltex Corp.
newsitem.headline: KEDO buys fuel oil from LG-Caltex Corp.

text.p: The Korean Peninsula Energy Development Organization (KEDO) bought 42,000 tonnes of heavy residual fuel oil from LG-Caltex Oil Corp, KEDO's broker International Services Corp said Friday.
The prices was $108.77 per tonne, basis FOB Yocheon Port, South Korea, with one vessel for May 15-19 and the other for May 20-24.
The freight contract was 20,000 tonnes to Nampo and Songrim, North Korea, at $15.40 per tonne, and 22,000 to Songbong, North Korea, at $12.75 per tonne.
KEDO, an organization set up to carry out an international accord designed to freeze North Korea's nuclear weapons program, has agreed to supply the country with 500,000 tonnes of fuel oil annually.
